title: First-variable naturality of finite locally free evaluation
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme, let $\mathcal F'$ and $\mathcal F$ be finite locally free $\mathcal O_X$-modules in the sense of [lem-sc-ext-evaluation] (each restricts to a finite free module $\mathcal O_{V_a}^{\oplus d_a}$ on the members of an open cover, the ranks $d_a$ allowed to vary; compare [def-amb-finite-locally-free-module]), let $u:\mathcal F'\to\mathcal F$, and let $\mathcal G$ be an $\mathcal O_X$-module. With tensor products and sheaf Hom as in [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product] and [def-pur-sheaf-hom], write $\mathcal F^\vee=\mathcal{H}om_{\mathcal O_X}(\mathcal F,\mathcal O_X)$ and similarly for $\mathcal F'$. Under the canonical evaluation isomorphisms of [lem-sc-ext-evaluation] $\mathcal F^\vee\otimes\mathcal G\cong\mathcal{H}om(\mathcal F,\mathcal G)$ and $(\mathcal F')^\vee\otimes\mathcal G\cong\mathcal{H}om(\mathcal F',\mathcal G)$, the map $u^\vee\otimes 1$ corresponds to precomposition by $u$; equivalently, the square formed by these maps and the two evaluation isomorphisms commutes.
